protocol.tie_rule: ROUNDING, STATED SO IT CANNOT BE READ TWO WAYS. (1) The deviation is metric(prediction, realized) rounded to 6 decimal places; that 6-dp number is what is published and is the ONLY input to the tolerance. Ties are exact and are resolved by the stated convention, not by whichever binary double the arithmetic happened to land on. null_rule_panel.law: A rule is INFORMATION-NULL iff it reads only rows of the fit source at or before the origin. Every rule below satisfies that by construction: each receives only (fit_years, values) truncated at the origin and the target year, and cannot see the resolution vintage at all.
null_rule_panel.admission_procedure: THE PANEL IS OPEN AND VERSIONED. It is not a claim to have enumerated every information-null rule -- no panel can -- so the contract states how a rule enters instead. (1) ADMISSIBILITY: a proposed rule is admissible iff it is INFORMATION-NULL by construction (it reads only rows of the fit source at or before the origin and cannot reach the resolution vintage), DETERMINISTIC (no seed, no randomisation), and IMPLEMENTABLE FROM ITS PUBLISHED FORMULA ALONE by a reader who has never seen this builder. (2) PROCEDURE: admission is an AMENDMENT -- public proposal, adversarial referee round, independent verification, maintainer ratification by merge -- and it increments panel_version. (3) EFFECT, which is mechanical and stated in advance so nobody has to be trusted about it: F2_panel_min is a MINIMUM, so adding a rule can only lower it; every tolerance it touches gets TIGHTER or stays equal; a pair whose new tolerance no longer sits strictly between the measurement lower bound and the panel minimum is DEMOTED to reported-not-gated; therefore the gated set can only SHRINK, never grow, and no admission can loosen a tolerance or admit a candidate the previous panel would have failed. (4) NO SELF-RESCUE: under gate_1's inherited amendment rules an admission binds only runs registered after its ratification, so a candidate that has already failed cannot be rescued by a later panel change and a candidate that has already passed cannot be retroactively failed by one. (5) THE WORKED EXAMPLE IS PUBLISHED: null_rule_exposure.out_of_panel_probe_set measures 35 unregistered rules against the v3 surface, and null_rule_exposure.counterfactual_if_every_probe_were_admitted computes the exact surface that admitting all 35 would produce.
null_rule_panel.verifier_rule_count_discrepancy: the independent verifier's report says it built 45 rules; its scratch program work/verify_residual.py defines 41 distinct rule names. All 41 are registered here. Three further classes the report's PROSE names but its script omits -- medians over 2 and 7 rows and a cubic on the last 8 -- are registered too, so the panel covers every class the verifier described, not only every rule it ran. mean_last3 is in the prose class and was already a v2 member, so it is not double-registered. 11 + 41 + 3 = 55.

power_cap.law: POWER CAP, in the locked gates' grammar. A (cell, horizon) pair is gate-eligible only if tolerance(cell, h) <= cap(cell, h), where cap(cell, h) = (1 - 1/1.5) * (realized(cell, T*+h) - origin(unit)) and origin(unit) is 0 for abs_pp and 62 for abs_years. The factor is ln(1.5) transcribed into an absolute-deviation metric: |ln(pred/realized)| <= ln(1.5) is pred/realized in [2/3, 3/2], and the widest absolute band entirely inside it is realized/3, the low side binding first. The origin is the zero of the quantity's own scale: a share of zero is meaningful, a claiming age of zero is not, and 62 is the statutory earliest entitlement age and this table's own first category. A pair over its cap is REPORTED, NOT GATED -- demoted as in gate_2 and gate_m4, not clipped as in gate_m6, because a clipped tolerance would no longer equal rho * F2_panel_min and the skill-ratio reading would need a second rule.

power_cap.factor_derivation: |ln(pred/realized)| <= ln(1.5) is pred/realized in [2/3, 3/2]. The widest absolute band entirely inside that ratio band is |pred - realized| <= (1 - 1/1.5) * realized = realized/3, because the low side binds first: an absolute band of realized/2 would admit pred = realized/2, a 2x error.
power_cap.why_62_for_abs_years: a ratio cap on a mean claiming AGE is meaningless -- the scale has no true zero and realized/3 would be about 21 years, a cap that caps nothing. 62 is the statutory earliest entitlement age and the support floor of this very table, whose first category is age62, so realized - 62 is the quantity with a true zero: it is zero when every award is claimed at the earliest possible age.

pass_rule_draft.pass_rule: Pair-level conjunction with a rolling-origin stability leg. LEG 1 (registered origin, T* = 2012): the candidate passes leg 1 iff EVERY gated (cell, horizon) pair is in band -- deviation(candidate, cell, h) <= tolerance(cell, h) -- with no n-of-m allowance over pairs, cells or horizons. LEG 2 (rolling-origin stability): the candidate is re-fit at each rolling origin 2004-2012 and re-scored against the same panel-derived tolerances. The nine origins are partitioned ONCE, globally, by stride 5 on the ascending origin list, giving the five blocks {2004, 2009}, {2005, 2010}, {2006, 2011}, {2007, 2012}, {2008}; the partition does not depend on the cell, the horizon or which targets are admissible. An (origin, horizon) whose target year is excluded (2013, 2020-2022) or absent from the resolution vintage imposes NO CONSTRAINT. A block passes iff every gated pair is in band at every origin in that block for which the target is admissible, and leg 2 passes iff at least 4 of the 5 blocks pass. THE GATE PASSES IFF LEG 1 AND LEG 2 BOTH PASS. A single breach of leg 1 fails the gate.
pass_rule_draft.leg_2_block_law: LEG 2 BLOCKS, ONE RULE. The nine rolling origins 2004..2012 are partitioned ONCE, globally, into five stride-5 blocks of the ascending origin list: {2004, 2009}, {2005, 2010}, {2006, 2011}, {2007, 2012}, {2008}. The partition does not depend on the cell, the horizon or which targets are admissible, so the block-level conjunction has exactly one referent. An (origin, horizon) whose target year is excluded (2013, 2020-2022) or absent from the resolution vintage imposes NO CONSTRAINT -- it is neither a pass nor a failure. A block PASSES iff every gated (cell, horizon) pair is in band at every origin in that block for which the target is admissible. Leg 2 passes iff at least 4 of the 5 blocks pass. The blocks are UNEQUAL by construction -- sizes (2, 2, 2, 2, 1) -- so the 4-of-5 allowance waives one origin if the singleton block {2008} is the one dropped and two origins otherwise; that asymmetry is an allowance, not a dispersion, and is disclosed as one.
